pages.title: Cannot Edit?
pages.text: Check who owns the display and its control policy. Trusted players need Trusted mode for control. Relinking and access management require the owner or an operator. Re-enter Settings to fetch current access rules.

pages.title: Different Images?
pages.text: Check that displays use the same Screen ID. Turn off Local image override if a display should follow the shared image. A blank network remains blank until a permitted player selects an image.

pages.title: Import Failed?
pages.text: Use PNG, JPG, or JPEG. Check server upload/download settings and storage limits. For URLs, use a public direct image link. Local and private-network URLs are blocked.

pages.title: Server Configuration
pages.text: Server owners can edit config/simply_screens.properties to control viewing distance, uploads, URL downloads, file-size limits, and storage quotas. Keep backups of worlds, image files, and registry data before upgrades.
